summary: Retained with restrictions: country x week; label is whether flu positivity in the target week four weeks ahead exceeds a threshold, asked at the closing Sunday. The published vv2026.10 files are self-answering under cross-row joins (6,022/6,831 eval rows covered, zero mismatches, blind AUC 1.0), so unrestricted batch access is not a valid benchmark surface. Supported as a retrospective development corpus under the isolated-rows interface once it is mechanically enforced.
supported_uses: Retrospective model-development experiments under the runner's isolated-rows interface: public eval rows for development and model selection, sealed labelled holdout for final scoring
Research use of the construction, provenance and honest baselines on the frozen artifact
unsupported_uses: Claims of verified real-time or operational forecasting validity
Unrestricted cross-row batch access to the public files as a benchmark surface
Reporting public-eval scores as out-of-sample forecasting skill
Any benchmark score produced by a solver holding the public files, including scores indistinguishable from honest ones: the join recovery is deterministic

cross_row_audit.scope: Independent operator-commissioned audit; predictions frozen before labels were opened; holdouts sealed; two AUC implementations in exact agreement

limitations: join (country, W) -> (country, W+28 days): the next row's inf_all_w and denom_w are the operands of T's label
The labelled holdout is presumed to carry the same self-answering structure by construction; it was never opened by the audit and must be treated as compromisable by the same join class.
Historical feature/label availability at the declared instant is assumed from current snapshots, not verified against release vintages.
The current scorer passes the complete feature frame to predict_proba; prediction-time isolation is instructed but not mechanically enforced, so any framework score on these files is gameable.
required_actions: Run predictions through the isolated-rows interface once implemented (issue #17); the current scorer passes the complete feature frame and does not mechanically enforce prediction-time isolation
Keep the labelled holdout outside evaluated workspaces and never load later rows when scoring earlier targets

Versioned rebuild (next release tag) at a common information cutoff, or a chronological as-of interface, with outcome-bearing later rows and lagged fields purged; re-run the blind join battery before any stronger claim.
Site page and Hub card must carry the suitability record's restrictions once Codex integrates them.

evidence.detail: join (country, W) -> (country, W+28 days): the next row's inf_all_w and denom_w are the operands of T's label; 6,022/6,831 eval rows covered, zero mismatches, blind AUC 1.0

corrections: Public site page, Hub card and repository README must state the restricted suitability once rendered; no frozen package bytes change.
